entities.summary: Edwin Joseph Cohn was a protein scientist. A graduate of Phillips Academy, Andover , and the University of Chicago [1914, PhD 1917], he made important advances in the physical chemistry of proteins, and was responsible for the blood fractionation project that saved thousands of lives in World War II.
